canonical_name: Dark City Blues Jam (Black Mountain Blues Society)
summary: A weekly blues jam at White Horse Black Mountain, run under the nonprofit Black Mountain Blues Society (501(c)(3)) whose mission is to preserve and grow the blues community in Western NC. Named hosts rotate weekly (Peggy Ratusz and Bill Mattocks) and a house band provides backline for walk-up players who sign up on a sheet at the venue. It reads as a real ongoing blues-community institution rather than a one-off open mic, though nightly participation is still first-come sign-up rather than closed membership.

evidence.note: Listings describe a weekly late-night blues jam with drop-in/walk-up musicians, a house band, and rotating hosts, tagged 'House Band Provided' and 'Rotating Hosts' across 21 weekly occurrences from Dec 2025 to Apr 2026.

The Black Mountain Blues Society is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit whose stated mission is to 'preserve, celebrate, and grow the blues in Western North Carolina through education, outreach, and meaningful support for the artists who keep this music alive.'

Search summary of the 'White Horse Bad Ass Blues Jam' / Dark City Blues Jam listing: hosted 1st and 3rd Tuesdays by named blues figures Peggy Ratusz and Bill Mattocks, described as offering seasoned players a chance to 'sit in with a powerhouse house band'; sign-up sheet opens at 6:30pm at the venue.

White Horse Black Mountain's own event page frames this as the 'Dark City Blues Jam,' co-presented with the Black Mountain Blues Society, suggesting the venue's recurring blues jam nights (which our listings label 'Nothin' But the Blues Jam') are the same ongoing community series rather than a generic open mic.

Multiple dated YouTube uploads titled 'Nothin' But the Blues Jam LIVE at White Horse' (Nov 2025, Dec 2025, Jan 2026) confirm this is a recurring, filmed, community-attended series rather than a single unlisted event.
